items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I like him because his wife, Buttercup, was there.

ctx.x: He didn’t call me James, or Joseph, or nothing. He called me Curtis. So, something that stuck with and… I like him because his wife, Buttercup, was there. She was looking over and he needed that. So, having a chance to do this with him, it wasn't what I wanted to, or anticipated but, hey it is a chance to be with the master, you know? Three songs, we actually played another one with that. He had a little trouble with that one so I think they left that one out. This… I just rushed in there. The thing about this…
You know, I think we should wrap. As with all of these opportunities to talk with the greats in this music, I feel like we just scratched something and, you know I could spend like a week-­
